_comment: JSK1 — the first brand, and for now the only one.
The directory name is the hostname the brand is served from, which is also
the key js/cms-config.js resolves on. One name, one place, nothing to keep
siteId is the row in Supabase holding this brand's content. It reads oddly
because it predates the JSK1 name; renaming it would mean migrating live
data for no functional gain, so it stays exactly as production has it.
Adding a brand means adding a sibling directory to this one. It does not
mean editing js/cms.js, the generator, or any template.
name: JSK1
